title: SG-4.1.4 Unit test asserts phaser resolves to 3.90.x
summary: A unit test reads package.json and the lockfile and fails on a regression to Phaser 4.x
description: Context: game/frontend/package.json declares phaser ~3.90.0 and package-lock.json locks 3.90.0. Existing tests check each file separately and never check that both agree or the lockfile root specifier. Desired behavior: one guard test reads both files and asserts phaser resolves to 3.90.x. Expected result: any change to 4.x in either file fails the test. Why: Phaser 3.90 is a hard stack requirement.
acceptance_criteria: Given package.json and package-lock.json on disk, when the guard test runs, then it passes only if phaser resolves to 3.90.x in both
Given a package.json or lockfile that references phaser 4.x, when the guard check runs, then it reports a problem and the test fails

in_scope: Guard unit test reading the real files

technical_constraints: Use the aliased NodeURL import with fileURLToPath as existing tests do
definition_of_done: Guard test exists and passes on the current files
A 4.x fixture is proven to fail
non_functional: Test runs in under a few seconds
